metadata.description: Open-source (MIT) Claude Code plugins for running a small team with AI agents and shipping AI features.

plugins.name: control-tower
plugins.description: Run a small AI agent team through files: 3-role starter, inboxes, decisions queue with defaults and undo lines, 3 KB handoffs, spend caps, status view.

plugins.name: eval-kit
plugins.description: AI eval setup for teams shipping AI features: golden + holdout sets, graders, runner, release gate.

plugins.name: mcp-forge
plugins.description: Plan, scaffold and review TypeScript MCP servers so a product works inside Claude and ChatGPT.

plugins.name: agent-ops
plugins.description: Free agent-readiness check against a 6-area rubric, plus a reference operating model for companies run with AI agents.

plugins.name: agent-newsletter
plugins.description: Draft a newsletter issue from your agents' handoffs, decisions and failure notes, with a no-financials filter.
